memories.summary: Started as ordinary goblin in small nest under Grak.
Reached isolated house, killed the man, took the woman captive. Months spent there training and using her.
Daily intense conditioning has made body significantly stronger, faster, and more enduring for a goblin.
Learned basic common tongue from the woman over weeks of lessons. Can manage short functional sentences.
Dependence with the captive woman has deepened through care, sex, and routine. She shows passive acceptance and automatic responses.
